summary: Verified that compact Android and iOS navigation show text and voice channels together under their General category and preserve direct channel selection and DM navigation.

checks.name: Mixed text/voice drawer and navigation on Android and iOS
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/widget_test.dart --name 'mobile drawer lists General text and voice'
checks.observation: Both 390×844 widget cases pass. Each checks the General category, one text channel and one voice channel appear without separate Chats/Voice filters; voice selection starts direct admission and closes the drawer, text selection returns to the conversation, and the DM control opens the direct-message panel. The Android case supplies a mock response for the native USB audio route cleanup used after the intentionally rejected voice admission.

checks.name: Android empty drawer at 320 dp
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test test/widget_test.dart --plain-name 'mobile drawer fits 320 dp with no channels'
checks.observation: The empty-state copy fits at 320×640 without rendering the obsolete Chats/Voice filters or producing layout exceptions.

remaining: Manual Android/iOS navigation and visual comparison on devices remain part of the broader parity acceptance.
